title: mac-nr: Make defines and value strings for LCID values.

notes.body: We often add a field for reserved bits
I prefer the convention where none of the strings end with "MAC CE" - it is implicit.
The convention in this dissector seems to be to use - rather than _ to separate works within the filter

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12623/diffs?diff_id=816965036&start_sha=afeaa0e354b3f23b461bf966c8fc5617581eb3c3#21a22406f58650b0f5c990891e896860e8e957ef_3485_3487)
I prefer the way the fields are grouped with whitespace above, i.e., FT_UINT8, BASE_DEC|BASE_EXT_STRING, &

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12623/diffs?diff_id=816965036&start_sha=afeaa0e354b3f23b461bf966c8fc5617581eb3c3#21a22406f58650b0f5c990891e896860e8e957ef_3497_3499)

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12623/diffs?diff_id=816965036&start_sha=afeaa0e354b3f23b461bf966c8fc5617581eb3c3#21a22406f58650b0f5c990891e896860e8e957ef_3503_3505)
In spec is written without spaces around '-'

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/12623/diffs?diff_id=816965036&start_sha=afeaa0e354b3f23b461bf966c8fc5617581eb3c3#21a22406f58650b0f5c990891e896860e8e957ef_659_657)
I think we could just #define these as decimal numbers?  I believe the hex was really just a hangover from the way it was in MAC-LTE
This looks good to me, see comments
